recognize_zh: 脾臟切面瀰漫性暗紅、無結節（A），顯微鏡下紅髓竇與索被中型淋巴瘤細胞填滿、白髓消失（B），免疫染色呈竇狀分布陽性（C），肝臟竇狀隙（D，箭頭）與骨髓竇（E，箭頭）也出現竇內浸潤；肝脾骨髓三處皆為竇內（sinusoidal）分布是肝脾 T 細胞淋巴瘤的特徵。
features: Panel A: enlarged spleen with homogeneous beefy dark red cut surface and no discrete nodules
Panel B: red pulp expanded by monotonous medium-sized cells with round nuclei and pale cytoplasm in cords and sinusoids, white pulp not evident
Panel C: immunostain highlighting tumor cells in a sinusoidal/cord pattern throughout the red pulp (antigen not labeled)
Panel D: liver with clusters of atypical lymphoid cells within hepatic sinusoids (arrow) without portal-based mass
Panel E: bone marrow biopsy with subtle intrasinusoidal lymphoid infiltrates (arrows) in a fatty marrow
describe_en: Composite figure. The spleen (A) is enlarged with a homogeneous dark red cut surface lacking nodules, and histology (B, H&E) shows diffuse red pulp expansion by monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells with loss of white pulp; immunohistochemistry (C) highlights the neoplastic cells in a sinusoidal/red pulp pattern. The liver (D) and bone marrow (E) show subtle intrasinusoidal infiltrates (arrows). Findings are consistent with hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma, which typically expresses CD3, CD56 and TCR gamma-delta with CD4/CD5/CD8 negativity and isochromosome 7q. Note that the record category (subcutaneous panniculitis-like T-cell lymphoma) does not match the title or images.

ddx.vs: T-LGL shows intrasinusoidal CD8+/CD57+ cytotoxic cells with granular cytoplasm but an indolent course, preserved white pulp and usually TCR alpha-beta.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma / hairy cell leukemia
ddx.vs: These B-cell neoplasms also fill red pulp but express CD20 (and CD103/annexin A1 in HCL) rather than T-cell markers.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia is EBV (EBER) positive with surface CD3 negativity and often hemophagocytosis, whereas HSTCL is EBV negative.
Congestion expands red pulp with red cells and fibrosis but lacks a monotonous atypical lymphoid infiltrate.
